module.purpose: Defines the Zustand store factory that manages React Flow nodes, edges, viewport state, selection, connections, and internal layout updates.
module.summary: This module constructs the central React Flow state store and wires public state mutations to system-level graph, viewport, selection, and connection utilities. It supports controlled and uncontrolled node and edge updates, maintains lookup indexes, applies middleware, coordinates fit-to-view behavior, updates node dimensions and parent expansion, and forwards change notifications to consumers.
module.businessContext: Supports interactive node-based graph editors and workflow diagrams. Failure disrupts graph editing, viewport navigation, selection, and synchronization with application state.
